answer:
I couldn't find a documented auto-scaling GPU cluster mode in llm4j or Loom, so I can't show you how to turn one on. The nearest things I did find are choosing a model per agent by name, including a local Ollama model, and a `routing` policy that falls back between models in order or picks by cost. Routing decides by your rules, and whether a cheaper model is good enough is what your evaluation tells you.

What are you trying to get: more throughput, lower cost, or running on your own GPU hardware?
